name: Markdown Preview
description: Render Markdown into sanitized HTML and build a heading table of contents.

hints.markdown: The source may be up to 1 MB.
hints.flavor: GFM adds tables, task lists and strikethrough; CommonMark follows the standard syntax.
hints.allowHtml: When off, raw HTML is escaped into text. When on it is still stripped of scripts and event handlers.
hints.breaks: Turn this on to render a single newline as a line break, which suits chat transcripts.
hints.output: The HTML is **always** sanitized on the server; the page only shows it as text and never renders it in place.

faq.q: Why can I not see the rendered result?
faq.a: To avoid XSS the page never injects the HTML, it only shows the sanitized source. Paste it into a renderer you trust to see the visual result.
Not by default, it is escaped into text. With "Allow inline HTML" the layout tags survive, but scripts, event handlers and `javascript:` links are still removed.
They follow the GitHub rule of lowercasing the heading and joining words with hyphens, keeping CJK characters. Repeated headings get a `-1`, `-2` suffix.
